title: The action of a 1-dimensional integer multiplicity triple carried by finitely many rays is the sum of its integrals over the ray pieces (parent step 8)
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, let R = (M, θ, ξ) be a 1-dimensional integer multiplicity triple in ℝ^P (IMRep univ 1), and let F be a finite set of unit vectors with H¹(M ∖ ⋃_{e∈F} ray(e)) = 0, where H¹ = μHE[1] and ray(e) := {te : t > 0}. Then for every test 1-form ω ∈ 𝒟¹(ℝ^P): R.action(ω) = Σ_{e∈F} ∫_{M ∩ ray(e)} θ(x)·ξ(x)(ω(x)) dH¹(x).
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) 1) (F : Finset (Euclid P)), (∀ e ∈ F, ‖e‖ = 1) → (μHE[1] : Measure (Euclid P)) (R.carrier ∩ (⋃ e ∈ F, (fun t : ℝ => t • e) '' Ioi 0)ᶜ) = 0 → ∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) 1, R.action (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) 1) = ∑ e ∈ F, ∫ x in R.carrier ∩ (fun t : ℝ => t • e) '' Ioi 0, (R.mult x : ℝ) * R.orient x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) 1) x) ∂μHE[1]
